This is a day when you could realize just what you have been missing in a certain relationship. You notice that, while on the surface it all seems fine, there is a distinct lack of real passion. That spark that makes you pine for each other when out of each other's sight is no longer there. Now you have to decide what to do about it.

You can employ all of the subtle skills at your disposal this evening. You will have the ability to look into another person's eyes and to know exactly how to melt their heart. Don't get your hopes up: this is not likely to be a particularly romantic day. Most of the passion you do experience will be in terms of conversation. There is a smidgen of hope!

Someone you have been trying to get know finally has the courage to tell you how they feel about you. This is a surprise, as only a while ago they wouldn't even look you in the eye!

If you are looking for that special relationship, then try not to adopt your usual appearance of dark and brooding intensity. The astral influence indicates that potential lovers will not respond to this call of the wild and are looking for an easier time. You need to lighten up and quit looking like someone who has just emerged from playing an extra in a horror movie.

The day gives you the opportunity to investigate all kinds of things you never normally get to explore. Doors open up to you that may have previously remained firmly closed. You won't even have to knock - others just know that you have what they want in big excessive quantities and aren't afraid to confront you with their desires. You may even have to make a choice!

The energy of the day brings out the devil in you. You have been thinking about the possibility of a relationship with a certain person for some time now, and a unique opportunity presents itself in which you can prove how utterly desirable and wonderful you truly are. You can fix your lover, or your lover-to-be, with that extremely powerful, very seductive, there's absolutely-no-escape kind of look, and watch as they crumble helplessly under your awesome gaze. Some interesting competition could arise between you and your friends. There is a good chance that a few of you want to date the same person, so how will you cope with this? You will need to use all of your seductive charm, and the full power of those intensely dark and intelligent eyes. You know you'll win but competing makes the process even spicier.

It may be time to try a more unconventional approach to love and relationships, especially today of all days. If you feel the need for a change, then do things differently. You will be moving in new circles, especially if you are single and looking for that special love. Take a break from your normal routine, and for once do things in a new way. Love will find you if you take time to meet new people and get involved in new interests.

Keep up the good work regarding your efforts at developing a new circle of friends, and a whole new set of interests. You will be given more of an opportunity to help out in whatever capacity feels good to you. You love being of service to others, and needless to say you are more likely to find romance in this setting than anywhere else.

The only way you can be allowed to stay as you are is if you are humoring your own behavior. Experimentation at all levels best describes today's events, especially in your love life. You will be able to feel deeply about a situation that you may previously have only been able to think about. Although you generally like to stay behind the scenes and make sure that things run smoothly from there, today you will be forced to come out of the closet and enjoy being yourself. Intense desire convinces you that someone really cares about you. If you are single and looking for romance, then don't waste time sitting inside and daydreaming. Get out there and start communicating with others. Find people whom you can befriend, and to whom you can bring help and comfort, and you will soon have some wonderful companions.

You are usually too polite to mention certain problems to a loved one. However, now you feel a lot bolder and able to deal with whatever comes up. Change of a most positive kind is in the air, most likely involving your domestic situation. You tend to get stuck in a routine, and this can often be a problem when you wish to move on and do something different. Consider some new and very different options in order to exercise your imagination. Rather than banish these fruitful ideas about a new life and wonderful partnership, why not spend some time considering if they might work?

If you are able to go out to a small party or other gathering, then you may need to find some way to keep your feet very firmly anchored to the ground. You'll be provided with a great opportunity to take time out to talk with your romantic partner. You may have both been busy lately, with different and very pressing issues to attend to. It is time to take a break from your usual punishing schedule, and to then decide on what you would like to do for an evening of fun and entertainment. Break all of your usual rules and move beyond the boundaries that keep you tied to a limited social circle. There is a whole exciting world out there to explore.

You shouldn't think about your current plan too much. The more you think, the more you tend to confuse the issue, and the more you run around in circles. Stop for a while and just relax. You may abandon your usual practical common sense and find yourself carried away by a tide of passion that surprises both you and your partner (current or prospective). It is no good disguising your grief or angst behind a host of ills today instead of telling your partner (current or prospective) what is really on your mind. You might need to go against the grain and let go of any barriers to a night of profound and undying passion. This may surprise you as much as it surprises and pleases your love interest. You will find yourself in a situation in which you begin to feel more at home with your partner (current or prospective), because for once you have the opportunity to understand what makes them feel secure at a very deep level. Action is the name of the game in love and relationships today. Try and see things from the perspective of your partner (current or prospective), yet not to forget about your own needs. It is getting the balance right and doing things together that make you happy that will bring out the best in both of you.

Be more tender and loving toward your love interest. If your relationship is currently thriving, then expect to feel like getting even closer to one another once again. If you have just met that special someone, then you may find the force of attraction greater than you imagined. Be prepared for more than you originally bargained for.

Now's a good time to loosen up and drop some of your petty concerns about your sweetheart. If you have been feeling uptight or have been blaming your partner (current or prospective) for all kinds of things that perhaps they are not entirely guilty of, then it may be time to give them a break. Rather than complaining, try taking them out for a well-deserved meal.

You and your partner (current or prospective) will find the time to sit down and work out a plan of action concerning a purchase. All you need to do is balance your finances and make sure that you are both getting what you want for the money.

You feel jumpier and more irritable than usual, which could have quite an effect on your love life. If your partner (current or prospective) already understands your varied moods, perhaps it is best to spend some time alone and try to relax.

As you usually set the precedent for anything new and experimental anyway, But you may be able to act in the role of tutor to people who need a little help in setting themselves free, and allowing themselves to be the unique people they truly are. Through reaching out, you will open others' hearts.

Although you may find the today's energy a little too emotional, it won't hurt to talk over certain issues with your special friend. This is a great day for a small party, if possible, as you will have the chance to invite new and very different people into your circle of friends. On a day like this, you will probably feel like taking your love interest out somewhere exciting to spice up your flagging love life. If you are seeking to expand your social circle, and want to explore the possibilities of a new relationship, then this is a day that offers you the chance to communicate with a completely different set of people whose ideas and motives are exciting and far-seeing. This will really suit you, and out of this may come the possibility of meeting that very special person.

You may be tempted to get off the fence, as the option before you is so truly exciting that you just cannot resist it. You may find love and love affairs hard going today. A certain ambivalence on the part of your partner (current or prospective) is likely today. Pretty soon you will find that your friend is anything but diffident.

This is a wonderful day for arranging a get-together with close friends, if possible, and also for daring to invite someone special whom you have been quietly flirting with for some time. Pay attention to your feelings, which you often do tend to ignore. This time, however, it is more difficult to cast aside the wisdom of your heart in favor of the ramblings of your restless mind. If you need to summon your courage to let someone close know how you feel, then make the most of it the opportunities that come your way. Some intriguing and deeply romantic situations are on today's agenda. You love to converse with others, but today, one conversation in particular contains a real sense of magic. A much-needed sense of detachment from a certain relationship that has proved fairly troublesome lately is set to wash over you today. You'll be able to muster up the courage to get in touch with to the person who has captured your heart. Take time to get in touch with your deeper feelings concerning your most personal relationship. If you have certain issues that need discussing, then do so while you are able to offset any difficulties with a degree of charm. Sometimes the moonlight plays tricks upon us, and at other times it creates the kind of atmosphere that is so celebrated in love poems. Rather than having just one major relationship at the moment, you seem to be working on a number of them all at once. You are used to discussing things with others in such a way that you encourage them to see life from a new perspective. Relationships are like multi-faceted doorways into wonderful new dimensions. They create opportunities for you to move in circles that are both exciting and challenging. You may not feel in a very romantic mood today, as the planetary energy could dampen your usual joy and happiness a little. The astral energy at play brings some wonderful conversations into your life. It is through getting out and talking with others that you could meet that special person. There is a lot of dreaminess in the air today. The energy emanating from the planets gives a very surreal feeling to everything. The energy in the air spells a great day for you and your partner (current or prospective).
