The year begins more concerned with the mundane but important daily life issues, but with no upsets or setbacks here your attention may begin to expand to bigger realms of your life. Horizons may broaden in November when friends become interested in new places, cultures, or simply new restaurants. Be good to yourself (and your stomach) in February. Work seems steady and not overly demanding. If you're not growing flowers, a lover may start bringing them before year's end!

Be articulate and charming this year, and perhaps speak for those who can't speak for themselves. You know what matters. Work and finances look stable enough to permit more public involvement - and enjoyment, too. Cultivate diplomacy and find energetic companions in the first month. In November interact with sympathetic friends, but don't be overly ambitious. A home affair may need attention in January. People will offer help should you request it. Respect your health and energy level in February. Be highly visible in June. People will remember and seek you out again in July and August. Better than fame - bask in good luck, good deeds, and love!

Communicate with a lot of people and get your message across this year! You know what you need, want, and would like to share with the world. It doesn't have to be in words. You're already clever, but observe and develop more in October. Money or some possession may also take on new meaning, so be alert. November is busy with friends and maybe some fantasies. Budget your time. Kick-start something big and wonderful at home in January. Shine in public in June, and take that popularity with you to the end of the year. Add great good luck, regal pleasures, and abiding love!

It's a great year to focus on career and work-related plans and desires. If choosing or building a career, networking and word of mouth are two of your most powerful tools. Your public presence and communication skills are topnotch, and you'll be seen and heard, whatever you do. Make it good! Your keenest discrimination (and perhaps the most valuable lesson or insight of the year) comes in October. Be wise with money in November and quick to act in December. Be bold with a partner in April. Shine brightest in June, attracting a year's worth of luck, love, and happiness!

Work and home will cooperate and support each other for you this year, when there's not an emotional tug of war happening. Be practical, do your best wherever you are, and don't get pulled either way. Make wise decisions in the first month, and don't second-guess yourself. Be thoughtful with expenses in November. Friends amuse you in December, but don't exhaust yourself or your credit line. Someone at home may want you in January. Springtime could freshen up the romance scene. Be your best, most solid, and most popular at work in July. This shines straight into your home and love life through year's end!

Feelings and emotional attachments drive a lot of this year for you, especially about your work and public image. If you're shy, it may be uncomfortable for a while, but there are advantages to a high profile. Act thoughtfully in October. Something nice could become affordable in November. Let others do the loud talking in December. Something you already love at home could improve in January. Be flattered by a repeat offer of love in the spring. Gain more support, experience, and respect in June. Your heart leads the way through a year of brilliant achievements and great love!

Enjoy great social activities and being part of a larger crowd! Reserve energy for home and other daily needs, but break out of the mold. If not yet up for excitement, sit quietly until the spirit moves you. Honor your own needs and opinions in the first month, enjoy mutual material support with a loved one in November, then brace yourself for a busy, buoyant December. Invitations, phone calls, and texts - some romantic - pour in during the springtime. Screen those calls in April. August glitters with happy company and big events. Slow down but don't cool down in the last month, when love may be sweetest!

Many lucky chance encounters can happen for you this year! You might never meet again, but your lives and hearts will be touched, perhaps in a deep, permanent way. The first month is rich with self-discovery. Be grateful for insights and lessons. Finances are stable and sensible in November and remain so even when tested by social demands late in the year. Do what matters to you in December - good friends will join you. A brash love interest may find (or re-find) you in April or May, to return yet again in August. Keep your heart strong! It's a magnificent, memorable year!

Feel regal and act with nobility! That's how people see you, however you feel. Strong, true feelings and powerful, clear thoughts are yours in October. Remember or write these down. An old favorite comfort may sustain you through any insecurity in November. Be gentle but firm if challenged by friends in December. Healing dreams are yours in February. Be realistic and health conscious, too. A romantic fling or celebrating the anniversary of one brightens your world in April and May. Daily responsibilities remain under control and in the background, so the last two months can be as fun filled and socially satisfying as you please!

Form your own impressions and make your own observations this year. Your firsthand experience has never been so important. The first month, a karmic discovery awaits you to put a few puzzle pieces together. Trust your judgment in November, but don't be too proud to double-check, particularly regarding money. A false impression or too much wishful thinking in February could be corrected near the end of the year. It's never too late - or too early - to raise that psychic antenna and sharpen those powers of rational thought. Your heart will benefit, too, and attract just the right kind of love and lover!

Be your most charming and persuasive this year one on one. Social and public settings will be pleasant and successful enough, but you'll excel on the more intimate stage. Late in October be considerate of others and yourself. Combine shrewdness and tact to your financial advantage in November. If you take more initiative on the romance scene in April, it may still be hard to resist some old, cozy groove. Regardless, enjoy the good times. Good luck and high spirits in August may be fun but not so easy to share. The last month is all yours for your heart to treasure!

Step into your own light this year! A karmic peek into your own mind is possible in October. Get finances and expenses under firmer control in November. Fun and adventures near to home are on your cosmic agenda in December. Friends will encourage this. Love and be loved in a bolder and more vocal way in March. Disagreements shouldn't be necessary. Even you should notice a more self-confident, outgoing mood by July and August. Connect better with more people in the last two months, and leave room in your heart for that most intimate and special one!

It's a year of self-discovery, and the awakening of new passions and self-love! Remember any birthday dreams and let a week pass before looking for hidden meanings. Be financially responsible and solid in November, just on principle. You're on sound footing. You may need some amusement with friends in December. Love, with all its thrills and risks, enlivens the springtime. You won't have to be outrageous to get noticed. Your social life heats up in August. Be popular and see new places with new people. Pay more attention to your health and appearance in the last month. It will make you even more lovable and charming!

Be so mentally sharp and observant that others suspect you of reading their minds. Overlook nothing, however small, and then easily make sense of what the world shows you. Your psychic talents (and they're considerable) are in addition to these mental skills. Be at your best in October, and use what you learn all year long. December is active with friends, neighbors, and casual acquaintances. February is creative, fun, and dreamy. Love sparkles and amazes you in March and April. Be the figurehead in your social set in August (although you don't have to pick up every tab). It's a powerful, empowering year!

Material well-being and basic financial health may attract your attention this year. The first month may give you a clearer picture of where and what you want to be in relation to others and the world at large. You may feel a tinge of insecurity and dissatisfaction in November and December. Hold yourself to realistic standards (not impossible ones), do the spreadsheet, and see that you're really fine and under control. Indulge in more free-spirited thoughts and pleasures in February. Be relaxed but diligent all year long, and enjoy a few glamorous moments in August. It's a year of love and treasures!

You may discover that the world really does love you and that you are your severest critic. Finances may come under close personal scrutiny this year, especially in November and December. Be reasonable and realistic, then treat yourself as well as you try to treat others. Why imagine crises far worse than anything real? Spend time with friends in December. Enjoy artistic, spiritual, or just plain fun in February. You deserve it. Follow your heart and surprise yourself in April. Be safe, of course. Be more big-hearted in August and let others enjoy your company. Let others love you at year's end!

You could be the life of the party all year long and dance the nights away. Friends, neighbors, and favorite family members are there for you - and you for them - when things get challenging or stalled this year. You may feel under budget constraints and in less than a party mood in November, but that turns around in December. A sudden, necessary change at home in January can greatly improve your peace of mind and family relationships. Love may crash in on you in April. Enjoy the thrill and don't feel threatened. Social life spins in high speed in August. Thrill to it all!

It's a fiery, big-hearted year in which it may be hard to refuse any offer or request. Friends and neighbors won't intend to intrude on you or your resources so much, but you may offer more than is practical or necessary. This may occur mostly in December. Be calmer and just as friendly, and be creatively inspired in February. A languishing or long-forgotten relationship might flash to life in April. If it doesn't ring true in your heart, well, life is change, is it not? Be gracious anyway. August is a gloriously social time. A provocative love turns positively sweet at year's end!

Friends and fun times close to home will make this a pleasant, relaxing year! You may save your special charms for an intimate few, but everyone will enjoy your company and idea of fun. Make some new friends and try out a fresh social scene. Money is fine, but watch that budget in November. A big change at home in January may keep you close, but there are great things to do nearby. A partner or love interest could surprise you in the springtime, or you may be the one doing the surprising. Friends are your good luck! Be loved all year!

Home and being happy may be big priorities this year. You're practical minded and no doubt have some new ideas to make your home environment more to your liking. Spend some of November writing down and costing out those plans. Friends will be there in December to help you make changes and relax afterward. February may be the busiest or tensest. Relax and enjoy what you're doing. A creative or spiritual activity in March can help keep you on track. Romantic excitement could light up your life in April or May. It's a sunny year rich in comfort, company, and love!

It's a great year to bring home life and social life into better accord and surround yourself with happy family and friends. Your playful, clever nature encourages people to listen to what you have to say. Older people and relatives may be drawn to you - and be generous - in November. Be busy and renew contacts in December. January may draw you deep into a home concern that will greatly enhance your overall environment. Don't stress over any changes. Love suddenly enters the scene in April. Enjoy some rare peace and quiet until August reignites life with big fun and affection!

Listen to your inner child this year and watch happiness and creativity bloom! You're completely practical and methodical, so most people won't suspect your wild, playful inner life that makes everything else possible. Be conservative about spending, especially in November, and have plenty of resources for the artistic fun you need. December could bring many invitations to parties at friends' homes. Intimate is good! A major change or shakeup in January could startle you out of taking your own home for granted. Great goodwill come from this, so relax. March is creative, April is loving, and summer is big fun! It's a transformative year!

Your inner child is near the surface this year and will lead you to many joyous and creative times! You're smart and naturally cautious, so there should be very little risk involved. You may be especially cautious regarding money in the autumn, but this will relax and leave you with more than enough resources for everything you need and want. You may crave new romantic excitement in the spring. Work and rest well so you can be ready for a boost in your social life in August. The last few weeks of the year may be the loveliest and most affectionate of all!

Goodwill and the desire to help others may be what you want most to do this year, and that's wonderful so long as you take good care of yourself, too. Think clearly and responsibly in the first two months, have energy to burn in December, and be ready for any surprise from any friend in January. Maintain healthy habits in February and March. A change in partners is possible in April, or perhaps an improvement in attitude between you. It's all good. The last two months are gloriously busy, fun, and romantic, so rest up and be good to yourself!

You have a high-energy year ahead, with plenty of motivation to sweep through those important little things that used to slow you down. Start by being methodical and patient, step up to being more efficient and capable (especially regarding money) in the second month, then you can burst out, perhaps with a few friends, and tackle the world in the third month. A disagreement or amazingly happy surprise from a partner may arise in April or May. After a few unperturbed months to work as usual, celebrate and enjoy congratulations from friends and lovers. It's a satisfying, spectacular year!

Love could light up your world in a big way this year! If already together, what is already great may get unbelievably better. If single, that state may not last. If not interested, well, that could change. The first quarter of the year is rock solid and practical. You may imagine problems with money in November, but nothing is seriously wrong. Dream and enjoy big fun in February. Love explodes on the scene in April. After a few months to cool down, big-time romance strikes again in August. Step back from the limelight and cozy up with your special flame at year's end!

You're especially well loved and appreciated this year. You may not hear the words, but they'll be in people's hearts. Charm and exquisitely clear thinking are yours, starting with the first month. If you feel nervous about money in November, by December you'll see just how well you're doing. Take good care of yourself in March and April, and don't be caught off guard by illness or fatigue. Love embraces you from family, friends, and that magical secret other in May. Continue treating yourself well and meeting life's daily necessities, and be ready for a splendidly social summer. Love overflows in the last month!

Love is rarely so luxurious and secure as it will be this year. People will love you on sight, and that special someone won't be able to do enough to make you happy. Your deeper, more serious nature will only make you more desirable and mysterious from the first month on. You'll be interested in everything and friends won't be able to keep up, especially in winter. Be safe and healthy in April and pampered in May and June. Social life and work may overlap, to everyone's benefit, starting in August. The last month may be the most charming and charmed of all!

You have all the energy and tenacity you want or need this year, so don't hesitate! You'll do everything with class and composure, too. You'll always have the right word for the right person, starting in the first month. Your authority and money decisions will be sound and unquestioned in November. Reserve time and happily blow off steam with friends in December. Respect your own well-being in March and April. In May someone may need a substantial favor. Do what you can and feel good. Work gets busy and lucrative in the summer. Love and luxury round out a great year!

Communicate perfectly, say what you really mean, and hear what others really intend. With your infinite charm and irresistible smile, people will gladly answer your questions. A subtle sense of humor endears you to people in the first month. Your patient, practical grasp of money matters impresses others. Don't be anxious about anything this year. Time with friends may be important in December. A happy fantasy could make February pleasant. Take extra good care of yourself in April. You deserve it. Talk, listen, and maybe help someone out in June. Work is steady and generous, private life and love even more so!

Horizons broaden and the whole world becomes your learning place. The only hard part is staying focused on one thing long enough to fully understand it. It's no matter when life is this interesting, engaging, and fun! Think deeply and clearly in the first month. If you're insecure about money or possessions in November, relax. Things are fine. Be energetic and upbeat with friends in December. Be safe and health conscious in April. Maybe take a trip or watch an inspiring travelogue in June. You could have a lucky break or gratuity in the summer - oh, and extra-charming love as the year ends!

Connect with people you care about, no matter how far away or how long since you saw them last. Someone might contact you in the first month, or perhaps they'll just come to mind. You could get sentimental about an old possession or souvenir in November and want to spring into action and spend time with more people in December. Make a new spiritual friend or two in February. Be sure to take good care of yourself, and don't experiment with too many crazy new diets in April. Enjoy your work in the summer, and positively love the end of the year!

Feel at home anywhere in the world this year, and get attached to a few new favorite places, people, and things. Your great natural charm will make you popular no matter where you are. Your clear, thoughtful nature makes you easy to get along with. Being practical, energetic, and enthusiastic in the first three months will propel you through a successful, happy rest of the year. A brief escape into fantasy lightens up February. Play it safe in April. A trip is possible in July. Work is pleasant and plentiful in August. The last month is full of harmony, happiness, and love!

Be more visible at work and pay more attention to how others see you. In the first month you may fine-tune your appearance and think about how to control what others think and say about you. Just be your basic charming, competent self. Be motivated to improve your income and manage money more wisely in November. Take good care of yourself and glow with health in April. Advancement at work, or perhaps more satisfying work, is possible in July and August. Don't be overeager and chase any good luck away. It's a powerful, successful year full of richness and love!

You'll be on a lot of people's radar this year, and having such a public presence will bring you much good luck. Your mental and social skills are at their peak and work together flawlessly, starting in the first month. Pace yourself and don't overexert, especially in November and April. Money and possessions may motivate you in December, making it sometimes hard to slow down. Find artistic or spiritual release in February. You glow in the work world in August. An increase in money, reputation, and recognition are all possible. Be modest and know you're worthy. Enjoy a glorious, glamorous year!

It's a great year to launch a new career or business or build a public image. You have plenty of energy and motivation to excel at dealing with large numbers of people, making everyone happy. Speak with gentle authority in the first month. If you're feeling a bit old, that will stop when energy booms for you in December. Don't overextend or get overambitious, but reserve some of that extra motivation and money. Be joyful and inspired. Respect your health in February and March. Be strong and rested for summer - you'll be at your most conspicuous, competent, and lucky!

Associations, clubs, and social life are big - and lucky - priorities this year. People relate to you easily and enjoy your company, which can mean networking success. If you need more private time in the first month, it could be scarce. In December people will give you many leads and fuel your drive for more money and possessions. There could be a major shift or change in your neighborhood in January. Be safe and healthy in April. Star at work and perform well in August. Friends, fans, and supporters admire you in the last two months - and so does that special intimate someone!

Think big, talk with lots of people, and go out and be seen! It's no time to hide out with a small circle of friends and associates. Think instinctively before you act in the first month, and balance charm and mature sophistication. A monetary windfall (maybe some borrowed money returned to you?) or valuable gift may find you in December. Say thank you. Dream big in February. Avoid needless risks in April, and play it safe and happy. Be more prominent at work in August, and don't shirk from being more in charge. Get social and popular in September. It's a fun, fabulous year!

You can build complicated teams and partnerships and keep as many of your actions as quiet as you please this year. You can achieve a huge amount behind the scenes, and people will appreciate your discretion. You're at your most charming and clever. Your authority is strong in the first month. December ignites your drive to acquire better income and possessions. Wishful thinking in February attracts people to you in March. Be realistic and take care of yourself in April. A lucky career break or some public action raises your prestige. The last month is extremely powerful for you - smart, sexy, and immensely comforting!

Take the soft approach and use your infinite charm and sharp wit, starting in the first month, and be successful and well received all year long. Act with authority and maturity. Respect your health and any physical limitations, however. Find new sources and connections for income and desired possessions in December. A sudden change near home could affect you and your friends in January. Be healthy and safe in April and stay active and energized. Work is lucrative and lucky in the summer. The last month is intimate and full of luxury and love! It's a magnificent year!

Popularity and charm are among your greatest secret weapons this year. You seem to read people's minds and hearts, and nobody can resist your personal magic one-on-one. Speak with a more conservative and respected voice in the first month. Work hard behind the scenes in December and be rewarded for your efforts. Share your creative imagination with others in February. Take some extra precautions in April and respect your health. Eat and rest well. Good times and generous work situations fill August. In the last month thinking is stellar, feelings are powerful and empathetic, and love is tremendous!

Niceness gets serious for you this year as you realize just how great it is to be able to be both. A deeper side of you emerges early, and people instantly respect you more and listen to what you have to say. You can modify this to suit your place and company, and your instincts will be flawless. Be smart and ambitious in December. Be conservative and a bit self-protective in April and commanding at work in August. Things go your way socially in September. The year ends with you in full control of your critical thinking and tender feelings. Love and be loved deeply!

Think clearly, sharply, and quickly all year long. Others may get confused from time to time, but you'll instantly see through to what's most important to solve any problem. Be good to yourself, but don't take yourself too seriously, especially in the first few months. Work hard in December and see material gains, though not as big as your dreams. Dream big again - spiritually this time - in February. Work opportunities and good luck explode for you in August. The last month is for retrospection, a bit of cool quiet time, and maybe some hot love! Have a sharp, sizzling year!

You're on fire to make your mark and win whatever prize has caught your eye. While money and material possessions may be the superficial focus, your mind and heart won't stop there. Being responsible and mature gains you popularity as the year begins. People will work with you in December to the material benefit of all. You're extremely practical and motivated, a powerful combination. Enjoy a meditative or spiritual respite in February and emerge stronger. Be safety conscious in April. Be prominent and effective at work in August to even more benefit and respect. In the last month reflect, relax, and get romantic!

Your mind and heart are strongly in sync this year, bringing great material progress. You add sincere charm and maturity to everything you do, and people respond to this. Take your well-being seriously, and be at your strongest and best all year long. Self-motivation gets practical in December, and doors will open and lucrative offers will be made to you. Be proactive, inventive, but cautious in April and see daily benefits, however modest. Be popular, masterful, and in charge of your situation at work in August. Your private thoughts and most intimate feelings come out full force at year's end!

This is a high-octane year for you, when there will be no stopping you once you get going! Money and possessions (including your own body) are of utmost concern, and you'll pursue the best and the most you can achieve all year. Your serious concern for others gives you a great advantage, and so does your determination to take care of business. Be smart and steer clear of any risky situations or actions, so be safe and healthy. Be lucky at work in August, though everything might not be easy. Enjoy a year vastly rich in affluence and affection!

Friends and good times near to home smooth out a busy year. You're popular and people trust you. Slightly more old-fashioned manners or presentation could improve how people see you. Be keen and active in pursuit of more income or material acquisitions in December. Heavy-duty January is when friends or neighbors might present a scare. Don't get nervous or paranoid… Stay cool and practical and help others cruise through the event. Good feelings and intentions abound at home. Good health and basic safety deserve extra attention. Perform well at work in August and gain prestige and possibly future benefits. It's a brilliant year!

Desire for security and good times with friends and family may tug at your heart this year. A gracious, graceful attitude endears you to older relatives and especially female friends in the first three months. A strong practical streak may cause people to turn to you for help and advice in January. There's plenty of time and outlet for pleasant times and fun, so don't let any imaginary fears ruin this for you. Home is a more magical and inspiring place in February. Be healthy and safe in April, and very successful at work in the summer. Have a bright, loving year!

Imagine what you want to do and have at home, and set in motion some of those changes now. Older relatives and friends - and possibly some older women friends - will instantly understand and support you. Work hard in December, see more cash flow, and save and apply to your future plans. A big change in the life of a friend or neighbor in January could further set you in motion. Be inspired and inspiring at home. Avoid any hazards, major or minor, in April. After some stunning good luck at work in summer, prepare for peace and massive love as the year ends!

Be lucky and prominent all year! You may be very productive behind the scenes, but you're going to be spending more time at center stage, so don't overlook how productive that can be, too. Cultivate extra charm and quiet good sense the first month. Money may come, go, and come again in January. This will only further motivate you. Home life becomes sweet and satisfying in February. Hearts meet and dreams come to life. Have mischievous fun in April. Dazzle people at work and in public, with recognition and reward to come, especially in August. Calm reflection and warm affection complete a great year!

Your fondest wishes and plans for home may take work, but you have the vision, the means, and the luck to accomplish wonderful things for your home and family. Accept invitations and suggestions in the first two months. A money matter could flare in January, resolving very much in your favor. Your home environment gets refined, dreamy, and more comfortable and comforting in February and March. Spread your wings and be creative in April. Work becomes important in August. Do your best, be gracious, and reap great rewards. September and October are more subdued and private. A romantic revelation answers a karmic question at year's end!

Have great fun and share great joy with many people this year! Derive maximum satisfaction by being creative and encouraging others to follow their dreams. You're attractive, smart, and patient, so the year may start slowly, but it won't be boring. Keep track of your money in January, and don't make any rash decisions. Home will be a dreamy refuge in February and March. The most intense time could be April and May. Make the most of it. Luck and popularity peak in July and August. Make the most of this, too. An important lesson in October will serve you well for a long time!

Surprise and the ability to turn the unexpected your way will be superpowers for you this year! Maintain control, don't get carried away with the thrill, and see great things happen almost on their own. Being popular and practical brings many friends and allies in the first month. A money surprise could happen in January, so be sharp and don't overreact. Relax with family in February. Watch for wild fun and romance in April. Be in the spotlight and prosper at work all summer long. Catch your breath and cozy up to a smarter, more serene relationship in the last month!

Be a bundle of energy on a daily basis this year! If work or home routines get boring, you'll find endless ways to vary things and keep your interest fresh. Take good care of your health and make incredible progress. Be financially motivated in January and generate some extra income. Be motivated for some fresh fun in April and May. Keep track of the little things in June. Expertly handle big things at work in August and see rewards. Schedule quiet time in the last two months and have a private insight with positive karmic results. Extra love and good company conclude the year!

Decide what you really want to have and then apply slow, steady pressure to make it happen! Be pleasant and practical with everyone, and make new friends to share your adventures this year. Impatience with money or some valued possession could cause some stress in January. Relax and don't imagine difficulties. In May and June you may question your resolve, but be systematic, trust your judgment, and find your answers. A big lucky break at work or in some other public setting in August could take you to a higher place. Love, wisdom, and a personal insight are yours this year!

Love, romance, and all things charming and seductive will surround you this year! Some will be fantasy, but very few. Love will have substance and solidity, to have and to hold. The first month set your intentions, establish your style, and let companions know what you like and expect. Appearances matter. Watch the budget because shopping could be big in February. A wild romantic fling in April has thrills but won't last. In May and June your heart settles down and you could meet that special someone. Be big-hearted all summer. Insightful discussion and deep affection fill the last few months!

Love sparkles as never before! If you're looking for that ideal heartthrob, more than one could show up at your door. If you're not, love is still going to be the prime mover for this year. In the first month you may have the tastes of a perfectionist, but you crave variety, too. One big night out in January might need the whole month's budget if you're not careful. Recover in comfort at home during February and March. June promises the most romantic times, thrilling new places, and elegant occasions. Feel regal (if not worshipped) all summer. Treasure those memories at year's end!

You'll be a natural problem solver this year. Even when there's no time to think, you'll spot the solution right away. As the year starts you'll be thinking in simple, direct, practical ways that cut through the most complex of situations. A financial matter in February will be easily resolved. Your people-pleasing skills will also smooth the way. Relax and enjoy home life in February and March. Kick up those heels and dance in April! Be the center of attraction in August. Watch the summer's great good luck persist all the rest of the year. Be especially loved and appreciated in the last few months!

Taking care of business ranks high for you this year, and a lot of that business may not even be yours. Be patient, listen, and take time to reply, especially with loved ones in the first two months. Keep to that budget and stay secure in January. Make your home more loving and lovely in February. In April surprise someone with an old favorite trick they've never seen you do. June and July may be busy with other people's concerns. Do what you can and have no regrets. Win hearts in August and win minds in October. It's a splendid, loving year!

Enjoy a lot of mutual concern and give and take among friends and family this year. No one will feel stranded or forgotten when times are easy or rough. Be the tactful voice of reason for your family in the first few months. Put more energy into increasing income in January, and see quick results. Mind the budget, though. Decompress with some mildly crazy fun in April and May. People may need one another in July - be there and be cherished. Be sublimely lucky and popular in August. As the year ends, be greatly respected, loved, and admired!

Big thinking and big family support take you very far this year! Spend the first month being clear about how you want to look and act, and then be practical about pursuing your immediate goal. Take one thing at a time. Some extra energy and attention to budget and earnings will pour added income your way in January. A sweet dream at home in February could enter the waking world. Be popular and widely respected in July and August. Casual friends may look at you differently after October. A true love will never lose sight of the real you, though. It's a love-filled year!

Take the long view this year and be bold in your plans for the future. Big changes for the better could be set in motion now. Practicality and good presentation will help you accomplish a lot in the first month. Be bold but not daring or reckless with money in January if a big opportunity comes your way. Nurture that big private dream in March. Creative boldness can bring success in April. See and be seen in July and August. Be self-assured and comfortable with others. You may reassess some of your decisions and opinions in the last month. Let yourself be richly loved!

Your challenge this year is to not doubt your great good luck and to feel deserving of all the success that's coming your way. You have all the social graces and good sense needed to achieve your goals, so step out of the shadows, smile, and proceed. The first month is crucial to building momentum, so allow no excuses. A financial opportunity could open up in January. Be smart and decisive. A spiritual touchdown may bring you comfort in February. Opportunity, timing, and popular support are all yours in August. Don't be nervous and look the other way. It's a bright, golden, love-filled year!

Your lucky star is shining bright, bringing you more popularity, respect, and recognition than you feel prepared to receive. People love you, and you return the affection. In the first month give thought to how you want the world to see you and then conform to your own view of you. Money may come and go and come again in January. Be practical and prepared. Spend some healing time at home in February. July and August will put you in the spotlight and bring many people your way. A quiet person may have a special love for you. Sweet, intimate memories reflect this rich year!

Career, prosperity, and success come together for you this year! As your daily work advances your career plans, happiness and fulfillment follow. Your authority will be respected, starting in the first month. People will like you and like how you do things. A business or money opportunity (or outright gift) might appear in January. Be sharp, smart, and gracious. Friends provide fanciful amusement in February. April has exciting fun. August and September are your months to shine brightest at work and in public. In the last month look back at how far you've come and see how much love surrounds you!

People will hear your voice and want to hear what you have to say! They will mostly agree and comply, too. Make new friends in the first month, though some may not last long. Money or a valuable article might come your way in January. You know how to take good care of things. Friends give you a spiritual lift in February. Crazy fun or hot romance flashes in April or May. Be thrust into the public eye in August, and be a central figure at work in September, all to your great credit. It's a smart, shining, and sexy year!

Let people into your life and they will take you good places! If not much of a joiner or group person, you may become one in a minor way this year. After the first month you'll feel as attractive as people perceive you to be. Have confidence in your money-handling abilities, too, particularly in January and February when there may be more money to handle. Relax with neighborhood friends in March. Be bold but not reckless in April and May. Watch the budget in August and participate in community generosity. From October until year's end is rich in company and intimate love!

Trust yourself, let people support you, and succeed! Relax any severe self-criticism in the very first month and cheerfully go out there and try things. Energy, money, and a sudden opportunity are yours in January. Be sensible but not reticent. Talk to people and ask opinions and advice, especially in February. You'll hear hopes and wishes as often as practical tips. All may be useful in time. Be a rebel in April and then let it go. Get happily lost in a generous crowd in August. October and November have karmic insights and connections that show you just how deeply you're respected and loved!

Social life and friends may become more important to you this year! Be your normal, friendly self, but let your heart open to better appreciate true friends and kindred spirits. Money or some big gift in January could bring you new friends, some of them fair-weather ones. You'll spot them. Time with established, trusted friends in February more than makes up for past excitement. Break out in April with some passionate fun. Be safe, though. Dance in the big crowd in August and then waltz into October, when you may prefer a smaller group. The year is full of fun, good people and better and better love!

Have some brilliant insights about the people in your life. You don't have to share your new knowledge with anyone, though you might confide in one or two special intimates. People like you and will want to talk with you, especially in the first month. The second month, real life and money concerns may steal your attention and be of great benefit later. This could come in handy at home in April. Your social life picks up in August, though you may not feel totally connected with everyone. The last month gets intense, perhaps with a secret uncovered and the return of a deep love!

It's a new year and a new you with fresh passion in your heart! People may please you more, and they will be drawn to your sheer love of life. In January a passion - or just a better appreciation - for money and possessions could spur you to find more income in a more pleasing way. If a friend hurts your feelings in February, forgive and forget. Make a small but radical change at home and be happy. Do something social and grand, but affordable, in August. The last month look back critically but sympathetically on all you've done and enjoyed. It's a passionate, love-filled year!

Be your own shining light this year and see how many people love and follow you! No matter what great advice or recommendations you receive, your decision will be the right one. Let material concerns motivate you in January and perhaps acquire more than you anticipated. Be there for friends in February, but don't take everything personally. Touch up something at home and greatly please yourself, if no one else. August is festive, if expensive, so take care. The last two months are full of plans, reconsideration, and memories. You know who loves you. Be loved and love back. It's a very powerful year!

Your generous spirit drives you forward to happiness and success! Keep yourself in the equation of life, help others, and greatly help yourself. Material well-being is the focus of January, and you have energy and luck to profit from all your work. Friends offer relief, comfort, and fun in February. In March and April fill your home with a fresh feeling that's pure you. August can get exhausting and expensive, so respect some limits, as hard as that may be. The last month may have some frustrations, but don't get impatient or question any decisions you've made this year. Live and love to the fullest!

Money and material security may be on your mind a lot this year, and you have the resources and support to take care of it all! Cheerfully work hard at what you love, and banish any anxieties. From the first, people like you and want you to succeed. January brings the first and perhaps biggest opportunity to nail down more income and financial security. Be realistic, pragmatic, and proactive. Watch expenses in August, but don't stint or feel deprived. In the last two months appraise this successful year, with plans for more success to come. Be proud, love yourself, and be loved!

Be brave and bold-hearted and charge through the year! Nothing can hold you back once you set a direction and goal for yourself. Most of your energy and attention will go into practical projects, work, and money, so you could go very far indeed. January will be the most opportune time, so stay sharp and be ready. In the spring make a big personal change at home and have the comfort and peace you want and need. In August and September public concerns may impose, but you won't lose focus. End the year with a lot of gain in both material wealth and great affection and love!

The practical side of life will hold fewer mysteries for you this year! Finances and material possessions may occupy your attention, but you'll never lose sight of the bigger picture or forget what all your work is for. People will see this and want to be with you and help when they can from the first month on. January could be the most intense and busy, so be ready for anything. August puts you in the public eye or socially more central. In the last few months you'll see how far you've come, how much you've learned, and how very much love you're receiving!

Happy birthday greetings to you! If you're starved for new people, places, and things, you'll be thrilled with this year. Great variety and all things bright and beautiful will catch your eye, entertain, and enlighten you. You radiate charm, and people will enjoy your company. Extra money could suddenly appear in January. See how much you can retain. February and March are happy, stimulating times at home and on short outings with friends. August lets you indulge your passions in a bigger way with more people. Keep expenses under control if you can. The last two months hold the most personal progress and the deepest love and regard!

Be inspired by your friends and share your loftiest aspirations and goals with those most intimate with you. You're exceptionally charming this year, so people may spontaneously confide their dreams to you. Be sympathetic and respectful. Money and material concerns may take precedence in January. You'll be skillful and energetic without forgetting your inspiration. Friends and family reenergize you in March and April. Be dynamic and popular in public in August. A karmic moment at work in October reinforces your resolve. The last two months are full of love and heartfelt wisdom from someone who may know you better than you know yourself!

It's a pivotal year to complete something big or perhaps create a firm foundation for a long-cherished dream. Either way, it's a year of success, stability, and deep, strong roots into a prosperous future. Self-confidence and support from friends and family are yours. Money is there, too, though it may go out as well as come in. Budget and plan accordingly. What you enjoy at home and with friends in the spring will expand and bring you popularity in the late summer. By October you'll have accomplished a great deal and see ways to build on it. Love is part of your foundation this year, too!

An endless supply of quiet charm can take you through a busy, productive year. Be motivated to handle all manner of money issues in January, organize finances, and possibly see some improvement in income. Don't think big - think practical. February has plenty of fun and fantasy escapes with good friends. See your home in a new light in March and April and be more happy and comfortable all the rest of the year. Your small gestures and efforts will have big results, at work as well as socially, from August until year's end. Learn, love, and be loved in the biggest way!

Overflow with energy and passion, and see a lot of lingering loose ends tied up and laid to rest. A smile at the right time can resolve a problem. Imagine what an appropriate hug could do. January and February may be busy with earning more income and spending more time with friends, so be realistic and seek a balance. April and May enrich your home life and give you a stronger sense of direction. August may briefly put you in the public eye, but a temporary change can be good for morale. End the year smarter, more stable, and more secure in all your relationships.

This year you'll have a taste for fun and living life to the fullest. People will flock to your side, so there will be no lack of company or inspiration. You may do something new in the very first month that sticks with you for a long time. Keep expenses in hand during January and a better cash flow is possible. Friends provide dreamy entertainment in February. A family member could surprise you in April. Relax. It's nothing very new. Summer offers bigger boisterous fun. Balance work and play in October and benefit greatly. It's a year of popularity, generosity, and love!

Crazy fun and adventure may tug at you at times, but you have built-in restraints that keep the situation under control! Be both bold and realistic, and fulfill some of those dreams and urges. Your work ethic ignites in a big way in January, giving you opportunities to improve your income. Friends and big fantasies may fill up February. Enjoy, but don't expect perfection. A smart but crazy-looking idea may solve an old problem at home in March or April. Pursue your own plans uninterrupted, with a dash of big summer fun, and conclude the year wiser, admired, and greatly loved by someone you least expect!

Your daily routine can be a great source of pleasure and discoveries this year if you can sit still long enough! Restlessness may be an issue, but never boredom. Your natural charm will bring new people to you who will introduce you to no end of clever new places and things. Money should be abundant, though you might want to spend more, often intending to share. Enjoy, but remember to budget. Receive generosity in August and September. An observation at work in October enhances your people skills. Love and wisdom in love touch you in the last two months. It's an exciting year!

Romance and the yearnings for new love could fill your heart all year long. You won't need to go looking, since charm pours from your very presence. Be careful about whom you smile (or even look) at! In February imagine your dream partner and it could happen by June. Be wildly popular all year, especially in summer. From August until year's end people will want to treat you well. Respond in kind, as finances allow. A karmic meeting could occur in October, but it may not click until much later. Spend the closing months in a warm embrace of soulmate quality!

Love touches many aspects of your life this year. Be quietly popular and have many people seek you out for company and comfort. They won't all be needy - some will have comfort to offer you. Someone may appreciate a change in you that you haven't noticed or acknowledged. Money and material concerns may profitably occupy you in late January. Friends present a pleasant escape (and perhaps a small problem or two) in February. Open discussions and open hearts are a theme for the whole year, but especially June. People greatly love you in August. Gently touch many hearts by year's end!

Love of self, love of home, and that special tender, romantic love will guide this year! You may be lured into loving the outlandish, too, especially in the first month. Self-interest and a desire to have more to share will motivate you to work harder in February. Friends may urge you to relax in March. Consider it. Something you love at home may displease a loved one in April. By June it will all be forgotten. Be of service to people in August, and then give them the pleasure of pleasing you. Great love and keen insights are yours before year's end!

Great forces gather beneath the surface of this "low key" year! Your intellect and people skills are at their peak, but you may still crave some major change. Go easy on yourself and others all year. Money and your talent for finding more are more than adequate, though you may question this in January and July. Be realistic and plan accordingly. Let friends pursue fantasies in February. You may not want to relocate, but an opportunity could arise in April. Be realistic. Relationships and love surround you as the months unfold! If dissatisfied with your considerable progress, treasure all the love!

You don't have to solve everyone's problems this year, but you certainly have the strength and know-how to do so. Be sweet and firm as the year begins. See a radically different side of yourself in January. This can benefit you in your finances and in the work world in February and October. A change at home or with family could be big but no surprise in April or May. People may keep you busy with their problems in July and August. Listening can be helpful, too. Honesty and heart-warming clarity in an established love affair are yours in the final months!

It's a generous, joy-filled year when the good luck you lavish on others reflects back on you! The first month may be one of the richest, so open your heart right away. The second is rich in energy and drive to better yourself and your financial state. Although things are fine, anything can be improved. Friends can inspire you the next month. Home life could see a simple but radical improvement in April and May. Master a difficult situation in August and earn great respect. If your social life slows a bit, you may welcome the change of pace. It's a love-filled, generous year!

You may not feel like a perfectionist, but this year you are. You have that magic touch to do all the little things exquisitely right. Start the year listening and watching, and see method in any madness. Work diligently in February and earn money as well as fondness and respect. Keep aspirations high but expectations low in February and March. A surprise at home could distract you in April but won't make you careless. Be wise, generous, and lucky for others - and you - in August. Maybe cut back on social groups in November and spend more time relaxing with that special love!

Make plans for a trip that's been calling to you. It may not be far, but it will be far enough from daily routine to freshen your attitude, warm your heart, and expand your mind. Even an imaginary trip can make possible a brilliant, accomplished year. Be on the move in the first month and get inspired. Be ambitious and successful in January and February. You'll notice how much more you can do for yourself and others (with apparently no extra effort) in August and September. Then love your peace and quiet, and the cozy affection that comes with it, the last few months!

You may feel a tug of war between wanting to live on the grand scale but work on the ideal, detailed, smaller scale. Why choose when you can pursue both and succeed? Do serious brainstorming on the biggest plans the first month. The second month be motivated, ambitious, and willing to go it alone even if you're working on behalf of others. Respect a setback at home in April, but don't stop. August opens a lucky period. Share, then greatly benefit. In September focus on details and advance socially. Go slowly, love yourself, and attract lasting love in the last two months!

Be popular wherever you go! If not the brightest star, you'll still shine and hear people call your name. Your thoughts are lofty and your charm has practical aims. Surprise yourself in the first month. Be financially sensible and make great progress in February. Relax with some wild, crazy friends in April. Brilliant ideas and actions in August may not work out as planned. It isn't your fault. Smile and keep going. October is bright with popularity, success at work, and maybe a karmic gift. The last few months are calm, quiet, and passionate in all the right ways!

Find that ideal job, excel at the work you have, or maybe finally recognize the work that feeds your soul! You're also a powerful people person, so work that crowd and nurture those relationships. The friends and decisions you make in the first two months will mean a lot in the summer and fall. Make financial and business contacts in February and March. Break loose with friends in April. Enjoy being needed in August. Favors done now will return many-fold. Shine at work and in public in October, but be mindful of changes to come. Respect, admiration, and love are all yours this year!

Get serious about the work you love and see a year of success! It's easy to think through the big picture and then put together practical and popular plans that work like a charm. What looked like mere dreams last year can begin to happen in the first couple months. Be ambitious and focused on a dream in March. Extra money could follow. Friends may disagree in April but no one will leave you. Solve someone's big problem and make a big impression in August. Career opportunities abound in October. Quiet, sincere, long-term affection finds you and ends the year with love!

Career and a strong public presence can take you where you want to go! Clear, solid thinking and masterful social skills are only two of your gifts this year. Work hard in February, don't underestimate yourself, and improve your finances. Friends may tempt you into unwise but fun old habits in April. Be nice but stay practical and decline. Be big-hearted in August and September, but again, stay practical. A karmic lesson in October could redirect your career path. A change made now could have big ramifications. Be patient and wise. Indulge in more private - and more intimate - times in the closing months!

Social life may be more important, pleasant, and productive this year! How do the demands of your social activities add to or subtract from the rest of your life? At first you may want to do more of everything with everyone, but this will calm down in late February and March when you focus more on the practical aspects of daily life, pay bills, and earn more income in a pleasant way. Frivolous friends grow boring in April. Your generous spirit returns in August and September but in a wiser, more sensible form. Great progress, admiration, and affection conclude a powerful year!

Do countless good works and random acts of kindness this year. Most will be anonymous, so leave the glory to others. Be rewarded in other, more material ways, especially in February and March (when you might be most active and motivated). Step outside the box (not that you're in one) with friends and have some profitable fun in April and May. Do something small in September and come to the rescue in a big way for someone special. It's a year of blessing others and being blessed, most especially with love. Feel good about yourself and your whole life every day!

Spread those angel wings and fly this year! It doesn't get much more fun than that, and the benefits are great. Think things through clearly and practically on a daily basis, starting in the first month, and watch your daily life graciously improve. This includes dealing with money, especially in February. Energy and ambition peak now, and will carry you through several productive months. In August your generosity assists someone and brings you rewards, too. Do a public deed in October, small to you but big in others' eyes. Tender love surrounds you all year, especially in the last month!

Here's a powerful, peaceful year that's anything but boring! It's rare to get this much opportunity to focus on your own stuff, work hard, and move forward by leaps and bounds. The first two months are the most dynamic, but the whole year gives you elbow room for progress. Budget smartly and work hard in the second month and bring a dream to life. Friends may doubt in April, but they'll come around. Someone may need your support in August. A karmic door opens for you in October. Take good care of yourself from November on, and share more quality time with a special someone!

It's the year to treat yourself well and accomplish many things that the world has made difficult in the past. Surprise and maybe pleasantly shock a few people with your straightforward, practical boldness. The first two months hold the most stellar assistance, so work hard, get finances and budget in keen focus, then blast unhindered through the year. Shed a useless old habit in April. August lets you bless and be blessed. A karmic insight in October will improve many future relationships. The last two months are all yours, with love, quiet popularity, fondness, and comfort. You've earned it!

The year is full of remarkable insights and valuable lessons. Use them wisely and don't look down on yourself or others for any previous oversights or mistakes. Use the early months to hone your skills at managing money and earning more, if needed. Stand up for yourself and deepen friendships in April and May. Your heart is in tune with the needs of others in August and September. Be practical and all will benefit. The most valuable bolt from the blue may strike in October. Process it slowly and calmly. Be sociable and let others love you, especially in the last two months!

It's a brilliant year full of personal power and few obstructions to your goals! The opening weeks of the year are the most intense (and intensely helpful), so spot opportunities and pounce. You're full of energy all year, especially in the second month. Organize finances, nail down a realistic budget, and make great progress. If friends disapprove of something in April, it's simply a difference in taste. You know what you like. If expenses increase in August, be patient. It'll turn around. Make a karmic connection in October, then be socially active (but not wildly so) and privately pampered and loved!

Dreams of material bliss may inspire you this year. You're energetic enough to assure that a few of these dreams could happen, so stay realistic and resist the urge to give away as quickly as you acquire. Great things may be possible in the future, so yes, dream then plan wisely. The busiest months may be the first three, so act right away. Question old habits and stale advice in March and April. Be of great service - and be compensated - in August. A karmic partnership could broaden a horizon for you in October. Go places physically and emotionally. It's a loving, inspired year!

Be shockingly clever, socially smooth, work hard for your own causes, and make a lot of good things happen! Your own talents put you ahead in the first month. Skill at handling and pursuing money will advance you in the second. Be prudent in what you choose to do and come out ahead every time. You may bewilder old friends and family in April. Be understanding but undeterred. August lets you help someone out. Do it, if you can. Enjoy a cool, comforting social scene in the last few months, with great love in more intimate settings. It's a power-packed year!

Find countless surprising delights close to home and in the company of choice friends and family this year. Be amazing all year, but don't take yourself too seriously. The first two months are high energy - you can accomplish the most the fastest - so pace yourself. Be productive and see income improve. Emotions may calm down in March and April, but you'll have the most fun now. Work hard for others but don't exhaust yourself in August and September. Watch for enlightenment in October. November and December, tone down social interactions and see passion and affection pour in from a long-time lover!

Some old habits will surprise you and serve you well, but others may hold you back. You're smart. You'll see things differently this year. Be patient - wise decisions will follow. The first three months may be busy and confusing, so refuse to be rushed. Money and prospects for more income are good, especially in February, but don't be frivolous. You may be less than pleased with friends in March and April. Don't get short-tempered and emotional. Feel good about everyone again in August, and enjoy reciprocal generosity. In the last two months dispel any regrets about past decisions and accept great love from many people!

Home, luxuries, permanence, and stability may draw you more than in the past. In the first month use fresh ideas and social contacts to pursue a modest dream. Your energy bursts its bounds the second month, and nothing is too high for your aim. Be sensible and win admiration with your success. Money improves with persistence, so work hard and don't give it all away. Complete a big project at home April and May and feel secure all year long. Easily solve someone's big problem in August and gain more respect. A great, long-lasting love finds you in the closing months!

The comforts of home and the love of family may bring you great pleasure and be easier than ever this year. The first month you may effortlessly become the "heavy lifter" on many projects and not even notice. Skillfully make easy work of managing your own financial and material concerns, especially in February. Others might be helping behind the scenes. Surprising news could come in April. Be content and intuitive about home and family affairs in May. Be bustling and happy in August. Big crowds may be burdensome in November, but intimate groups and more quality love time can fix all!

It's a great year full of creative comforts and a few innocent "guilty" pleasures! Keep control of those expenses and even the guilt can go away, leaving pure pleasure. With a little thought in the first month, you can generate more charm and even sex appeal for the rest of the year. February brings ideas and opportunities to improve the money flow. April allows for some old favorite but still radical fun with friends. June is the richest and most creative. Be lucky for others and benefit in August. Slow down in November for some quiet, cozy, affectionate fun. Be smart but enjoy every day!

Have a blast and share your clever, creative happiness with everyone! You have the gift of charming, surprising, memorable speech, and you're quick on your feet. Be productive and busy with money matters in February, although your dreams may be bigger. Stay real and profit. Friends cheer and distract you in April. Do what pleases you most in May and June, though it may be hard to explain to others. In August someone else's concerns could cost some of what you gained in February. Be compassionate but sensible. Social contact may cool in December. Enjoy the peace. Big-hearted love is yours all year!

Love yourself more and let more love find you! Whether it's exciting and new or already established and deep, let a powerful love fill your whole year. An urge for change could strike you in April and bring new people into your life. Be passionate but respectful of your own needs and responsibilities. Everyone may idolize you in August and September. Enjoy it, but don't be serious about it. Your public image shines bright in November and December. Be modest and sensible and attract even more love. A social storm may briefly interrupt January. The year ends smartly and with an idealistic love.

Love those little rituals of daily life and maybe find a tender new love and partner to share more of your life. Sometimes the best things - and people - have modest appearances and are easily overlooked. Not this year! In April romantic sparks could fly and send you chasing after something (or someone) radically different. Go back to a quieter, more productive routine until August, when summer fun rocks the romance boat. The heart beats fastest in September. In late November be cool and connect with other cool heads. Friends, trusted companions, smart decisions, and lofty dreams are yours at year's end!

Passion runs high, so pay attention and don't miss out if a fated partnership, romance, or friendship appears out of nowhere this year! In April you may need a change, or just more excitement, so make an effort to not be impulsive or impatient with yourself or others. You'll want to work hard and make progress, especially in August, when you might overdo things and burn out for a bit. Be good to yourself. In late September and October a new person may enter your life, perhaps someone you first met in April. Passion turns practical in December, and love never leaves the scene all year!

Create more harmony and enjoy smoother partnerships of all kinds this year. People are cooperative and find you more fun to be with, starting in the first two months. Be sharp in April and make the most of unexpected opportunities and meet-ups with flamboyant people. Be accomplished in the following months, especially August, when what's best for you is also good for others. Love sweetens any deal made in October, but the pleasures may not last all year. Passions rise and you may work harder in December. Friends and lovers are all around you in January and February. Love and dream big!

Matters of the heart may feel serious and urgent this year. Consult your head, and sometimes put yourself in the other person's place for perspective and a sense of balance. In April you may be tempted to do or say something impulsive and a bit wild. Keep control of your emotions and spend more time with pleasant, agreeable people. Be ambitious and accomplished for several undisturbed months. Passion flares in August. Relax and be good to yourself. Be more easygoing and enjoy a summer-long party atmosphere. October could be tense and passionate. Relax more with friends in the closing months of an emotionally exciting year!

Be energized and serious about all you do this year! That includes having fun. You might be the center of excitement in April, or you may spring a huge surprise on everyone. Be humble in public and thrilled in private. Save some passion for your own well-being in August and have a great fun-filled summer. Other people take up your time in October, but it will be good for you later, too. Feel serious and work hard in December. In January a big change at work could happen around you. Stay settled. Friends and that special love are never far away!

It's a passion-filled year, equally filled with opportunities to take you far. Any hard work you're able to do will be rewarded. March and April are times for experimenting, perhaps even with a wild notion or two. Be sensible, not reckless, and be as ambitious and popular as you please. Keep up a steady effort and enjoy a glorious, glamorous summer. November and December are also busy, ambitious times. Don't doubt yourself now. If things are stirred up at work in January, you can come out on the lucky end. Be smart, ambitious, and idealistic all year. Be well loved and popular, too!

Make your mark on the world with steady, serious effort and sheer persistence. With so much passion and drive behind you it can be fun, too. Use April to think outside the box and try new approaches to old problems. Stay even-tempered and avoid getting hyper. Invent what you need. Summer fun and popularity will give you more opportunities and popularity in August. Try to moderate your activities, keep a sane schedule, and stay healthy. December is another prime time to shine, so do your best. Ride out any changes at work in January. Friendly affection and sweeter love round out a stellar year!

Your best efforts will take you far this year. Ambition is great and you're motivated to help others as much as yourself. March and April may be chaotic and full of accidental events and surprises. Stay safe and sensible, and see if any surprises can be turned to good. Maybe win some new friends as well. The next few months are calm and good for progress. August ignites with summer fun and big-hearted generosity. Keep things within bounds and let the limelight find you. Your unselfish work in December could win you love as well as acclaim and reward. End the year with warm romance!

Career and your standing in the world are highlighted and favored this year! Other people won't intimidate or distract you. In the spring be bold and inventive, sometimes to the point of shocking. Be practical, too, and don't get so wired or highly strung that you alienate anyone who may want to like you and perhaps work with you later. You'll settle down and be more systematic by August. Take care of yourself, health included, and don't shy away from being popular. Reach your peak at work in January. Be wrapped in tender love and caring friends in the final months!

Career and work opportunities beckon, so get ready! Be it an advance in your current position or the offer of something wonderful, look forward to moving from where you are to somewhere much better. Be energetic and willing to try new things in the first two months. Step off your normal path and sample some new and exciting activities.
